app.crashed: Something went wrong on this page.
app.waiting: Waiting for your profile and places to load…

onboard.intro: Enter your Wikipedia username to discover personalised editing recommendations — tasks that fit your skills, and new articles worth writing in your languages.
onboard.label: Wikipedia username
onboard.failed: Failed to load profile. Please try again.
onboard.eventLink: At an edit-a-thon? See its worklist ranked for you

loading.title: Loading {name}'s profile…
loading.sub: Finding your home wiki and reading your recent edits and the topics of the articles you work on. Usually 10–30 seconds. Tasks and suggestions load in the background once you're in.

nav.alertsHint: Get a notification when someone edits or tags one of your articles

overview.builtFrom: Built from your last {count} edits on {wiki}.
overview.focusUse: — used for "near you" tasks and local gaps.
overview.noPlaces: None of your recent articles are about a place, so tasks aren't limited to a region.
overview.liveEmpty: Watching {count} of your articles. Edits and new tags by others will appear here as they happen.

card.tasks: No tasks ready | 1 task ready | {n} tasks ready
card.tasksDesc: Articles that need work in your topics, your categories and near the places you write about.
card.revisit: None of your articles need attention | 1 of your articles needs attention | {n} of your articles need attention
card.revisitDesc: Articles you created or edited a lot that picked up tags, suspicious edits or suggestions.
card.discover: No articles to translate | 1 article to translate | {n} articles to translate
card.discoverDesc: Articles and sections missing in your languages, picked from what you already write.
card.contributeDesc: Your unused Commons photos, and Wikidata items near you missing your language.
card.guideDesc: Find uncited paragraphs, tags, missing sections and ready-to-paste sources.
card.statsDesc: Your edit streak and how many readers saw the articles you worked on this month.

tasks.title: Recommended tasks
tasks.sub: Articles on {wiki} that need work, found through your topics, the categories you edit in, articles like yours, and places you write about. Each card says why it's here.
tasks.guided: You're new here, so these are guided tasks: Wikipedia suggests the exact link or image to add and walks you through it in the editor. More kinds of tasks appear after about 200 edits.
tasks.geoRefining: Still working out where you edit — "near you" tasks will be added when that's done.
tasks.loadingSub: Searching tracking categories and Growth suggestions in your topics. Usually 10–30 seconds.
tasks.none: No tasks found for your topics on this wiki.
tasks.hidden: {n} tasks you voted down, dismissed or finished are hidden.
tasks.thanks: Thanks — this helps Compass learn what suits you.
tasks.voteFailed: Couldn't save that. Try again in a moment.

revisit.title: Revisit
revisit.sub: Articles you created or edited a lot that need attention: new maintenance tags (with dates), a risky-looking latest edit by someone else, or a ready-made suggestion. Problems that appeared after your last edit come first.
revisit.loadingSub: Reading tags, dates and the latest edit on every article you created or edited a lot.
revisit.clean: Nothing needs revisiting right now — your articles are clean.

discover.title: Discover
discover.sub: Articles and sections to translate into your languages, chosen by Content Translation's recommender from the articles you already write. Each link opens Content Translation with the article loaded.
discover.loadingSub: Asking Content Translation for articles related to yours that are missing in your languages.
discover.noSections: No missing sections found in articles related to yours.
discover.noGaps: No gaps found for your places, or your places haven't been resolved yet.
discover.gapReason: Located in {place}; has an English article but none in {lang}.
discover.monoSub: You write in one language, so there's nothing to translate. These widely linked articles in your topics have no {lang} article yet: write one from your own sources. (If you read another language, add a {babel} to your user page and Compass will suggest translations too.)
discover.monoEnglish: You only edit in one language, so there's nothing to translate yet. If you read another language, add a {babel} to your user page and Compass will suggest articles missing in it.
discover.monoNone: No gaps found in your topics right now.

contribute.title: Commons & Wikidata
contribute.sub: Work for photographers and Wikidata editors: put your own photos into articles, and fill in Wikidata items near you that have no {lang} description.
contribute.loading: Checking your Commons uploads and Wikidata…
contribute.loadingSub: Looking for photos you uploaded that no article uses yet, and Wikidata items in your area.
contribute.failed: Failed to load Commons and Wikidata tasks.
contribute.photosSub: {unused} of your last {uploads} Commons uploads aren't used in any Wikipedia article.
contribute.allUsed: All your recent photos are used somewhere. 🎉
contribute.noGapsNoPlace: No Wikidata gaps found — we couldn't work out a place you edit about.
contribute.openEvent: See this event's worklist ranked for you

guide.title: Article Guide
guide.sub: Shows exactly what to fix in an article: uncited paragraphs, dated tags, dead links, missing sections compared with English, a Wikidata image to add, and sources you can paste straight in.
guide.label: Article title for guide
guide.analysingSub: Reading the article paragraph by paragraph, plus its Wikidata item. Usually a few seconds.
guide.notFound: Could not load this article. Make sure the title is exact.
guide.clean: No problems found — this article looks well cited.
guide.missingSections: Sections in the English article but not here
guide.searchingSourcesSub: Journals, books and digitised texts, then formatting citations with Citoid.
guide.medical: Medical topic, so PubMed review articles come first (WP:MEDRS).
guide.checkEach: Sources the article already cites are left out. Check each one before citing it.
guide.start: Search for an article above to get started.

stats.title: Your stats
stats.sub: From your live contributions on {wiki}, not the cached profile.
stats.readers: Readers of the articles you edited this month
stats.readersNote: 30 days of views for {checked} of {total} articles
stats.compassSummary: {up} liked · {done} marked done · {edited} edited after you saw them

event.title: Your edit-a-thon, ranked for you
event.sub: Organisers run edit-a-thons with Wikimedia's Event Registration: signup, a worklist of articles, and progress tracking. Everyone there sees the same worklist. Paste the event here to see it ordered by what suits you.
event.refLabel: Event ID, Special:EventDetails link or Event: page
event.noWorklist: This event has no worklist yet, so there's nothing to rank. Organisers add articles on the event's Worklist tab.
event.rankedSub: {shown} of {total} articles on {wiki}, best fit first.
event.toCreateSub: On the worklist but missing on {wiki}. Writing one is a bigger job.

trends.title: Read today, needs work
trends.where: Most-read yesterday by {where}, that also carry a maintenance tag.
trends.none: No trending articles that need work right now.
trends.label: Trending articles that need work
